name: scrimba-explain
description: Explain by Scrimba — ask Codex to explain anything as an instant narrated slideshow: a concept, a document, an architecture, a codebase, a git branch or PR, or the changes it just made. Built live with animations, diagrams, maths, and code, at a scrimba.com link.

interface.shortDescription: Narrated explainers of anything, including the changes Codex made.
interface.longDescription: Ask Codex to explain a concept, a document, a codebase, a PR or the changes it just made, as a narrated slideshow with code, diffs, diagrams and animations, built live at a scrimba.com link. When Codex changes a lot of code, it offers an explainer of the changes.
defaultPrompt: Explain the changes you made in this session.
Explain how this codebase is structured.
Make a video walkthrough of this PR.
